=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11581-11596 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_diag_blob`, `_diag_total`, `_diag_in_progress`, and `_diag_queued` are assigned in top-level shell scope instead of being scoped to a function.
  WHY: In this long-running poller, those names leak into the global namespace and can collide with later code or sourced helpers.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11590-11595 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The jq extraction falls back through `2>/dev/null || echo "?"`, so malformed JSON or jq failures are hidden behind `?` placeholders.
  WHY: The new diagnostic loses the ability to distinguish a genuinely empty cache from parsing or execution failures, undermining the observability it was added for.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11584 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_load_actions_runs_cached` failure falls back to `{"workflow_runs":[]}`, making the diagnostic indistinguishable from a genuinely empty cache.
  WHY: A transient cache/API failure would be reported the same way as no workflow runs at all.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11578-11597 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic re-calls `_load_actions_runs_cached` instead of reading the memoized cache directly, so it relies on the current ready-flag side effect and could make a surprise API call if that invariant changes.
  WHY: The reviewer noted this is not a present correctness bug, but a future refactor that clears `_ACTIONS_RUNS_BLOB_READY` between calls would change behavior.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11592-11596 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: When `_load_actions_runs_cached` fails, the static `{"workflow_runs":[]}` fallback makes a cache fetch failure look identical to a truly empty cache.
  WHY: Operators reading the diagnostic cannot tell whether there were no runs or the cache/API path failed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11589-11599 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic branch is reported to run on the common no-stall path, not only when stalled issues exist and the active set is empty.
  WHY: If that control flow is correct as written, every poll tick with zero stalls would emit the cache summary and spam logs instead of only the intended edge case.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
